id: title:MattBro:restrict ownership backfill to provider fetched work domain orgs

review.posthog_relevance: Adds database-level filtering to the organization ownership enrichment backfill command, excluding records without a fetch history and those marked as personal-domain signups.
review.reason: Adds database query filters to exclude records lacking an existing OrganizationEnrichmentFetch record and those explicitly marked with work_email=False, preventing unnecessary API calls and processing of personal-domain signups during ownership enrichment.
